bibl.title: The Conversion of Pachomius Revisited.
bibl.seg: Christian Barthel, The Conversion of Pachomius Revisited.
Scrinium. Journal of Patrology and Critical Hagiography 15 (2019) pp. 30-43.
bibl.note: Argues that the historical core of the narrative about Pachomius' conversion is not only valid but also that the military has been severely underrated as a source of inspiration in the study of Pachomian monasticism.
